# Draft:Alawite Revolution in Hijaz

The story revolves around the battle of the Alawite uprising in Hijaz. The Alawites revolted against the Abbasids, and they were supported by some Umayyads. Approximately 5,000 Alawites and around 2,000 Umayyads were killed during the conflict. The story continues with Abu Ja'far al-Mansur leading a campaign against them. He successfully defeated the Alawites and brought an end to their uprising. His leadership was pivotal in quelling the rebellion and securing the Abbasid rule in the region
Sources: Research in the History and Islamic Civilization, Part One, Pages 89, 90.
